name: sound-bake
title: Sound bake
description: Bake and reflow for sound. bakeFrames() and bakeBuffer() turn FFT frames you already have (an analyser's bins) or an AudioBuffer you already hold into a small band-by-time table, once; drive(cache, atMs) is then a pure 0 to 1 scene intensity at any moment, still() is the steady value reduced motion gets, follow() is a smoothing envelope and segment() takes a chapter from a whole track. capture() reads a running analyser into the same table. Consent is untouched (decision 0015): nothing here creates, resumes or starts audio or reads the sound switch, and capture() returns null rather than wake a suspended context.

budget.reason: Two files counted raw with their comments: bake.core.js (the band reducer, a radix-2 FFT, drive, still, follow, segment) and capture.js (the analyser reader).

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
